m.d: If you have fun, you enjoy something.
m.e: Thanks! I had a lot of fun today. Let's do it again.

m.d: If you do something for fun, you do it because you enjoy it.
m.e: It's not my job; I just write Wiktionary articles for fun.

m.d: A fun activity, time, person, etc. is enjoyable.
m.e: I really like soccer. It's such a fun game.

m.d: A container is full of things if there are many of the things in the container and no more can go in.
m.e: The cup is full of water. If you try to put more water in, the water will fall onto the table.

m.d: A full moon is when the moon is a round circle because the sun is shining on the side we can see.
m.e: I can see the road, because there's a full moon tonight.

m.d: A person is full when they are satisfied, usually with food.
m.e: The meal was so large that I was full all day.

m.d: A funny is a joke.
Funny things keep people interested and can make people laugh.
m.e: That was a funny joke.

m.d: Funny things are strange and unusual.
m.e: This rotten milk has a funny smell.

m.d: The future is the time of something that hasn't happen yet. The study of the future is known as futurology.
m.e: I will be more careful in the future.

m.d: A look forward.
m.e: You have a great future ahead of you.

m.d: A future event is one that hasn't happened yet but will happen.
When you further something, you encourage it to grow.
m.e: Further the economy.

m.d: When you further something, you support it to progress or grow.
more; additional
m.e: Some further problems have come up.

m.d: When something is further away, it is at a longer distance.
m.e: We walked further than we had planned.

m.d: A funeral is a ceremony that honors someone who has died.
m.e: Everyone's preparing to go to Mary's funeral on Saturday at her family's church.

m.d: If you fully understand or do something, you understand or do all of it.
m.e: I have not yet been able to understand this idea fully.

m.d: Something use to make energy.
m.e: My car uses gasoline for fuel to make it go. My body uses food for fuel, it's what makes me go.

m.d: When you fuel something, you add on to it.
m.e: His words fuelled my anger.

m.d: Furniture are items used to decorate a room or make it more comfortable.
Something or someone's function is its purpose or its job.
m.e: The army sometimes performs a policing function.

m.d: A function is an organised event.
m.e: I met Sylvia at a church function last week.

m.d: If X is a function of Y, then X exists because of or is affected by Y
m.e: The speed of the computer is a function of its main processor.

m.d: If something is functioning, it is working and is not completely broken.
m.e: Her heart stopped, but her brain continued to function.

m.d: If something functions as X, it does the job of X.
m.e: In this sentence, "sentence" functions as the subject.

m.d: A fund is an amount of money kept for a specific purpose.
m.e: GM cannot afford to keep paying into the company pension fund.

m.d: An organisation's funds are the money that it has.
m.e: The school is raising funds to pay for the new library.

m.d: If you fund something, you give it money for its activities.
m.e: The project is jointly funded by the Government of Canada and the International Red Cross.

m.d: A person who has sex.
m.e: He is a great fucker because he makes me have an orgasm.

m.d: Too much activity, worry, bother, or talk about something.
m.e: They made a big fuss about the wedding plans.

m.d: A complaint or noise.
m.e: If you make enough of a fuss about the problem, maybe they'll fix it for you.

m.d: A show of affection or about liking something.
m.e: They made a great fuss over the new baby.

m.d: To be very worried or excited about something, often too much.
m.e: His grandmother will never quit fussing over his cigarette smoking.

m.d: To fiddle; to move about, or adjust; to worry something
m.e: Quit fussing with your hair. It looks fine.

m.d: Funds is another word for money.
m.e: If you don't have the funds needed, you can't buy this television.

m.d: If you are furious, you are very, very angry.
m.e: Bill was furious at John because he stole his lunch.

m.d: The hair of an animal.
m.e: My dog has very soft fur.

m.d: Hairy skin of an animal, often used to make of clothes.
m.e: It take many beaver furs to make a coat.

m.d: or (uncountable) Clothes made from animal fur.
m.e: She loved to wear fur.

m.d: If you fulfill something, you meet expectations.
m.e: He fulfilled his promises.

m.d: Fury is when a person is more than angry and usually is at the level of putting it to act.
m.e: The fury could be seen in the lion's eyes.

m.d: A fuse is a length of cord that will burn and is used to set off explosives.
m.e: After lighting the fuse, the miners moved away to a safe area.

m.d: A fuse is a switch used to set off an explosive.
m.e: The soldier carefully set the fuse on the bomb.

m.d: A fuse is a thin piece of wire that will melt if it gets too hot.
m.e: We lost power after after the faulty toaster made the fuse melt.

m.d: To fuse is to melt with heat.
Fuse is to mix or join two or more things together.
A fugitive is a person who has escaped from a place or is in hiding, especially to avoid arrest or persecution.
The fundamentals of something, are the main ideas or parts that it is built on.
If something is fundamental, it is basic and important.
m.e: The loss of her legs has caused her to undergo a fundamental change in how she looks at life.

m.d: Relating to the music genre of funk.
If something is funky, it has an unpleasant smell.
(vulgar,highly offensive) The plural form of fuck; more than one (kind of) fuck.
m.e: Go away, you little fucks.

m.d: If something is fuzzy it is covered with fuzz.
m.e: I like to pet my dog because he's fuzzy.

m.d: Vague or not clear.
m.e: My memory of the accident is pretty fuzzy.

m.d: Not focused; not clear.
m.e: I can see fine out of my left eye, but when I look at things with my right eye they're a little fuzzy.

m.d: A fuller is a convex, rounded, or grooved tool that is used by blacksmiths to shape metal.
A fuller is a groove made by the tool.
You use furthermore to add more information to what was already said or written.
m.e: We believe that the project is possible. Furthermore, we believe that we can do it within a few months.

m.d: Fusion is when two or more things come together as one.
In physics, nuclear fusion is when the nuclei of two or more atoms come together to make one new, heavier nucleus.
m.e: Fusion reactions make a lot of energy.

m.d: A genre of music.
m.e: My brother likes jazz music, but I like funk.

m.d: Something with an unpleasant smell.
m.e: His dirty socks smelled like funk.

m.d: A furnace is a machine that is used to heat a building.
A furni is a place that is very hot.
Fudge is a kind of chocolate that usually comes in squares.
m.e: We baked fudge for dessert.

m.d: If something is futile, it is unable to produce any useful results.
A fungus is a member of the Fungi kingdom of organisms.
If something is functional, it is working properly or normally.
m.e: The flashlight was still functional after I dropped it down the stairs.

m.d: A fundraiser is an event that aims to raise money by voluntary contributions for a particular activity or to defray costs for research of a cure for a…
A furry animal has its body covered with fur, a dense area of thin hairs.
m.e: Children often like furry animals because they are smooth when touched.

m.d: If you fulfil something, you meet expectations.
m.e: He fulfilled his contract.

m.d: If a person is fussy, they are anxious or show excessive concern about petty details.
A funnel is a pipe that is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom. It is used to guide a substance that is transferred into a container with a small opening.
If you funnel something, you pass it through a funnel.
If something is fundamentally true, it is true in a basic or most important way.
m.e: Their ideas are fundamentally different from each other.

m.d: If something changes fundamentally, it changes at the deepest level.
m.e: They fundamentally changed the design to improve safety.

m.d: To furnish is to give a place furniture or other supplies.
m.e: Our new house still needs to be furnished.

m.d: To furnish something is to supply or give to it.
m.e: My father will furnish me with gifts.

m.d: The act of gathering funds for something.
A fume is a gas or a vapor that has a strong smell, or is dangerous to inhale.
m.e: A strong fume was coming from the car's exhaust.

m.d: If something is fuming, there are fumes coming out of it.
m.e: The engine of the car was fuming.

m.d: If someone is fuming, they are very angry.
m.e: He's still fuming from the argument.

m.d: If you fundraise, you raise funds for a specified cause or purpose.
